name: Four Seasons Napa Valley
insider_take: This vineyard estate feels more like a private Tuscan villa than a traditional hotel, where world-class wine literally flows from the property's own organic vines.
whats_special: Set on a working vineyard in Calistoga, this is the only resort in Napa Valley where you can stay directly among the vines that produce your evening wine. The property features its own winery, Elusa, and sits on 4.5 acres of organic Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. The geothermal hot springs beneath the property naturally heat the pools and spa.
pro_tip: Book the vineyard-view suites during harvest season (September-October) to witness the grape picking right from your terrace, and enjoy complimentary tastings of the estate's limited-production wines.
dont_miss: The sunrise hot air balloon rides departing directly from the property, the farm-to-table dining at Auro restaurant featuring hyper-local ingredients, and the unique "vine-to-glass" experience where you can blend your own custom Cabernet with the resident winemaker.
pros: Prime location in world-renowned Napa Valley wine region
Luxury vineyard estate setting with premium wine experiences
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards and amenities
Exclusive access to wine tastings and vineyard tours
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive location and services
Remote vineyard location requires transportation for dining options
